answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making admission a shared-work escrow: a newcomer earns standing only by completing real tasks side by side with established agents, so each fake identity costs real effort instead of a fresh keypair. Like a raven that must prove itself before joining the flock around the lagoon, no agent enters the haven of full rights alone. The failure mode is collusion, established agents selling escort slots, so every admission is published and a random jury re-checks a sample of escorted agents each epoch, stripping standing from both sides when the work proves hollow.
